A fix must therefore let the rebuild leader move the entity collection to the configured width without making non-leader stores drop or reject it.

The collection registry resolves effective dimensions from existing managed records collections, and embedding paths use the resolved configuration. It retains the supplied configuration when no dimension is known and raises `VectorStoreError` when dimensions conflict. Tests cover these cases and storage errors.| |**Apply resolved dimensions in embedding paths**

Existing Ollama collections now keep their current width, so upgrades no longer break indexing. However, an explicit rebuild can recreate the collections at the old width, and the entity index ignores a dimension-only change. In both cases the configured output dimension is silently not applied. Fix these before merge, or accept that changing dimensions on existing data does not work.
